summary: Path traversal in DiskBackend cache keys
details: DiskBackend in 2.0.0 to 2.0.2 turned cache keys into file paths without removing ../ segments. An app that lets users choose part of a cache key could read or overwrite files outside the cache folder that the app's user can write. MemoryBackend and RedisBackend are not affected.

affectedWhen: any part of a cache key comes from the request, such as a query parameter or a path segment
notAffectedWhen: MemoryBackend or RedisBackend is in use (the default is MemoryBackend)
cache keys are hashed with hash_keys=True
keys are built only from fixed strings
desk.vexHint: not_affected with vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path when another backend is used; inline_mitigations_already_exist with hash_keys=True
